lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 5 to 7 horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a grid-like formation, extending from the posterior gill region toward the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect the horizontal spot rows, creating a repeating rectangular grid pattern across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature running horizontally along the upper third of the visible flank, exhibiting a sharp luminance transition with higher intensity values on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A non-uniform distribution of approximately 10-12 high-luminance blobs of varying diameters contained within the macro-mask of the first dorsal fin's silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated, low-luminance silhouettes indicative of remoras (Echeneidae) attached to the ventral and lower lateral regions of the subject.
